name: Pattaya Community Pet Hospital
addressFull: 248/6-8 Soi Nern Plub Wan, Nong Prue, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
afterHours: The official group emergency centre serves the Pattaya Community branch 24 hours.

emergency.notes: The Muang Ake group emergency page names Pattaya Community as a branch and says its 24-hour emergency and surgical centres are supervised by veterinarians and nurses. Current Maps, Petmap and the branch's own Facebook identity corroborate 24-hour operation. No separate after-hours number, surcharge, wait time, or explicit first-time-client policy was published.

petTravel.notes: Official Muang Ake group pages advertise international health certificates, microchipping, and rabies-titre testing and list the Pattaya Community branch phone. They do not state which steps are performed at this branch. The microchip page prints 'ISO 11758', not ISO 11784/11785. DLD export-permit processing and the destination laboratory were not published.

complaints: some reviewers report inconsistent communication or waiting
